research.title: MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion
research.snippet: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure.
